```yaml name: Deployment Summary run-name: Deployment Summary for ${{ github.sha }} on: workflow_run: workflows: ["Deploy to Novu Cloud"] types: - completed jobs: deployment-summary: runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' steps: - name: Get deployment info id: get_info run: | echo "environment=Production" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT echo "deployment_time=$(date -u)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT echo "commit_sha=${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT echo "branch=main" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT - name: Send deployment summary uses: dawidd6/action-send-mail@2cea9617b09d79a095af21254fbcb7ae95903dde with: connection_url: smtps://${{ secrets.EMAIL_USERNAME }}:${{ secrets.EMAIL_PASSWORD }}@smtp.gmail.com subject: "Deployment Successful - Production (main)" to: pawel@novu.co from: GitHub Actions body: | Deployment successful for Production environment. Time: ${{ steps.get_info.outputs.deployment_time }} Commit SHA: ${{ steps.get_info.outputs.commit_sha }} Branch: main View deployment details: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.html_url }} This deployment fixes the issue where duplicate "Powered by Novu" branding appeared when switching from block to HTML editor. Related ticket: NV-6101 html_body: |

Deployment Successful

Environment: Production

Time: ${{ steps.get_info.outputs.deployment_time }}

Commit SHA: ${{ steps.get_info.outputs.commit_sha }}

Branch: main

View deployment details

This deployment fixes the issue where duplicate "Powered by Novu" branding appeared when switching from block to HTML editor.

Related ticket: NV-6101
